name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused on gold projects in Nevada, USA. The company acquires net smelter return royalties and precious metal streams on exploration and pre-production properties, with its primary asset being a royalty position and exploration stream earn-in at the Lapon Canyon gold project in Mineral County, Nevada. Nevada Canyon operates as a capital-light royalty aggregator, building a portfolio of royalty interests without the operational costs of direct mining.
